question:
**Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.**

They have no reason to __trust__ you.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Believe**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Trust **is a belief in the reliability, honesty, and integrity of someone or something. (ट्रस्ट विश्वास)

 
 
• **Example**: *I trust my best friend with my secrets because I know she won't betray my confidence.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Believe **means to accept something as true or real based on evidence, faith, or conviction. (भरोसा रखना)
 
 
• **Example**: *I believe in the power of hard work; if you put in the effort, you can achieve your goals.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the synonym for "trust" is "believe".
 
• Trust often involves a deeper level of personal connection and reliability in interpersonal relationships, whereas belief can apply to a broader range of ideas and concepts.

Hence, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Condemn **means to express strong disapproval of something. (निंदा करना)
 
• **Dispute **means to argue or disagree with something. (विवाद)
 
• **Doubt **means to have uncertainty or lack of confidence in something. (संदेह)
